question: How does the fixed cpu-decode v2 g64f16/int16 path compare with pinned CPU llama.cpp Q8_0 on a cloud host that actually supports its ISA?
native_format: g64f16, transferred unchanged from the v2 calibration choice
order: Eight ABBA quartets per cell: native A0, llama B0, llama B1, native A1. Each quartet yields two chronological pairs (AB, BA) and one bootstrap block.
warmup: One full 128-step generation per process after loading and prefill, excluded from measured samples; every measured run rewinds to its fixed context and seed.
timing_scope: Complete single-token forward, LM head and greedy argmax, including forwarding the final generated token. Excludes load, prompt prefill, cache rewind, JSON output, and warmup. No native operation timers.
workload: Both engines prefill the same seed IDs repeated to the specified context. Each then follows its own greedy trajectory without EOS stopping. Token sequences are retained; this is matched geometry, not identical free-running text.
native_kernel_rule: Require all flags used by parse_kernel(vnni16): avx512f, avx512_vnni, avx512bw, avx2 and f16c. Reject the timing container before preparation if any flag is missing, and require the actual native kernel to resolve to vnni16 with int16 activations. Do not include FP32 fallback timings in this run.
cache: F16 K/V in both engines; no GPU layers or operation offload
affinity: The same first N distinct exposed physical CPUs from native discovery for both engines; strict persistent pools. Native is confirmed SIGSTOP-suspended when inactive. The baseline caller blocks on its command pipe and its real GGML pool is explicitly paused between windows, then resumed before rewind outside the decode clock; no external SIGSTOP is sent to GGML.
caller_binding: Hold the original v2 public CpuBinding for the native worker lifetime. The cloud sandbox makes repeated affinity syscalls expensive; the laptop path pins per operator. This harness therefore measures kernel and threading speed without that per-operator syscall cost, not unchanged laptop CLI performance. GGML already keeps its strict caller pinned.
response_timeouts: Worker load/prefill/warmup may take up to 1200 seconds. A 128-forward sample must respond within 120 seconds; an unresponsive sample aborts its cell, never produces a partial-cell timing result. These bounds and the cooperative baseline idle protocol were committed after an earlier no-result pilot stalled for 20 minutes; that attempt contributes no final samples.
llama_build: Release, GGML_NATIVE=ON, GGML_CUDA=OFF, GGML_VULKAN=OFF, GGML_OPENMP=OFF. Actual pinned CPU threadpool, strict affinity, poll50, repack enabled.
native_build: Release, CPU_DECODE_NATIVE=ON, CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-march=native. Compile both paths inside the running timing container, not on the image builder or artifact-preparation CPU.
pilot: Before final samples, compare flash on/off/auto using three pilot observations per setting in each cell. Select the smallest pilot median, breaking ties by on, off, auto order; retain all pilot data and exclude it from final inference. A separate full first-cell runtime pilot sizes the final booking to its elapsed time times six times 1.3; never pool that pilot's pairs into the final matrix.
estimator: Median chronological paired ratio llama_seconds/native_seconds, equal to native/llama throughput for equal steps. Also report each engine's median seconds, tokens/s and min/max spread.
uncertainty: 20,000 fixed-seed ABBA-block bootstrap resamples, seed 20261007, 95% percentile interval for the paired median ratio. Resample eight whole blocks, preserving each AB and BA pair. Intervals are per-cell, not simultaneous; cloud host variation is not fully controlled.
decision: Native win only if the ratio interval is entirely above 1; llama win only if entirely below 1; otherwise inconclusive. Do not omit losing, noisy or inconclusive cells or discard performance outliers.
environment: Record CPU model and all required flags in each probe and again inside the timing container; record lscpu/topology, process affinity, cgroup quota, compiler/CMake versions, build settings and model/config/binary hashes. Disclose any rented GPU container while computing only on CPU.

resources.gpu: none unless the CPU-only search fails; then the first probed GPU type with required CPU flags
resources.timeout_rule: Before the full run, book ceil(runtime pilot minutes * 6 * 1.3), including pilot container setup as a conservative margin.

artifact_cache: Download and prepare pinned model weights and GGUFs in the named cpu-decode-day-vnni-assets Modal Volume on a cheap CPU container. Mount it for timing, use model data offline and compile fresh actual-host binaries; never reuse staged native builds.
limits: Finish experiments by 2026-10-07 15:30 PDT. Keep all sixteen pairs of each cell in one accepted VNNI container. Commit every completed cell to the model Volume before streaming it to the client. After a dropped app, resume only validated completed cells, recording per-cell container/environment/build provenance and disclosing a multi-container matrix rather than inferring absolute thread scaling. Never pool incomplete pairs or runtime-pilot samples into final inference. Preserve the earlier AVX2 partial attempt separately. No laptop timing.
